Title: Source Links Feature
Content: MemorySmith supports SourceLinks on each MemoryRecord — file references with optional line ranges that ground memories in actual code. Each SourceLink has a Label, Uri, and optional StartLine/EndLine (1-based, inclusive). URIs can contain %VarName% tokens that expand via VarResolver using vars.json. The Variables page (/variables) provides CRUD for var bindings. The memorysmith_source_bundle MCP tool fetches records by id or hybrid search and returns file content slices for each source link. The memorysmith_find_by_source tool scans all records for source links whose URIs match a substring pattern and returns matching records with resolved URIs. Both tools support json and jsonl output formats. In MemoryViewer.razor, source links are edited one per line: 'Label | URI [| StartLine[-EndLine]]'. The VarResolver.ReadSourceAsync method reads file slices using StartLine/EndLine with a configurable max-byte limit and appends a truncation notice when needed. Default window when only StartLine is given is 50 lines.
